title: Operational metrics and value handoff
objective: Complete a metric card with no historical timing data.
clearance: Rewritten draft; pending SME and partner clearance

blocks.x: Value promised in pre-sales has to be provable after go-live. Metric cards make that possible, and they carry the value case into the success plan.

blocks.caption: Metric card (fictional support example)
head: Field
Example
rows: Mean active handle time for password and access cases
Minutes per case; tier 1 agents in the pilot region
Four-week sample before rollout (owner: support operations)
A hypothesis, set after the baseline is reviewed
Before go-live, then at 30, 60, and 90 days
First-contact resolution rate and re-open rate
Seasonality; case-mix changes; other process changes

blocks.x: Glean's Value Playbook says pre-sales value is only credible if it creates a measurable path for post-sales proof. The plan should cover success criteria, baselines, instrumentation, customer commitments, the timeline, and the handoff to post-sales teams. Adoption metrics help explain why value is or isn't appearing, but they don't replace the business outcome.

blocks.label: Boundary
blocks.x: Never use an aspirational target as a baseline. If the data isn't available, record the gap and assign measurement work. Never fabricate a before-and-after comparison.
The metric cards you write in the Blueprint should become the measures tracked after go-live. If they're vague, nobody can show at renewal whether the investment worked.

blocks.title: The metric card's lifecycle
blocks.alt: A four-step lifecycle for a metric card: defined in DITL, used in the executive business case, measured during validation, and reviewed after go-live.

practice.x: Complete the baseline field of a metric card when there is no historical timing data at all.

worked.x: **Baseline:** not yet measured. **Owner:** support operations. **Action:** time a sample of the agreed case class for four weeks before rollout, or enable ticket timestamps if they aren't captured.
The target stays a hypothesis until the baseline has been reviewed. Track quality guardrails and use comparable cohorts.
